authorization: User requested evaluating existing improvements under regulation and deploying those with reasonable evidence of superiority. This authorizes a passing candidate deployment.
construction: Apply only listed production source patches onto deployed baseline. No research tooling/default-off features or unrelated local changes in the release.
format: NC2000 engine rules, six registered/three picked, level 50-55, picked level sum <=155, shared current corrected referee, blind native observation matching Web lifecycle, exact native HP retained, 27000 iterations, c=0.4, hp_buckets=16, no pondering. Same 24-team catalog and 103-team weighted belief prior as deployed. Uniform catalog matchup draws; pair swaps agent side while preserving teams and battle/search seeds.

screen.selection: Highest mean score above 0.5. Ties prefer corrections, then legal_picks, then combined. No superiority or deployment from screening alone.

confirmation.selection: One frozen selected arm only. No changing candidates or expanding sample after outcomes. Screen results are excluded from confirmation estimate.

decision: Deploy only if confirmation posterior P(mean pair score>0.5)>=0.90 under symmetric Dirichlet prior total mass 1 across pair scores {0,.25,.5,.75,1}, and >=0.85 under total mass 4; observed score>0.5, no truncated/failed matches, legal replay and regression/build/browser checks pass. Report posterior conditional on pool, rule, model, and budget. No claim of global optimality or human calibration.
controls: Frozen arena/checker replay used previously. New workers: identity swapped pair control, deterministic repeat, full team validation. Existing record mutation controls retained. Test posterior on symmetric/positive/negative controls before measurement.
excluded: Already deployed waiting/healing/EarlyPerish fixes are baseline, not candidate gains. Rejected capped rollout damage, EarlyRest, root revisits, learned solver, expensive certified-endgame integration and other default-off mechanisms have no qualifying regulation evidence; do not revive or tune them on this cohort.
old_data: Previous 192-game combined comparison (99/93) remains inconclusive and is not pooled or extended. This is a newly authorized component comparison and independent confirmation with decision rule fixed before results.
